notes.title: Dawn of the Mexica v1.07 released!
notes.content: [p]Changes in this version:[/p][p][/p][p]\[General][/p][p]* Changes in Teonanacatl (Astral): Every few turns, some wall tiles can change their form and turn into tiles that produce various effects. There is additional loot, but all loot is more protected within the "walls." Alarm traps have also been added.[/p][p]* Changes in Mictlan4 (Cehueloyan): Temazcalme rock spawns now appear to provide help along the way and make the level more interesting.[/p][p]* "Jumping" skill added to the Warrior skill set.[/p][p]* "Evaluate Creature" added to the Beastmaster skill set.[/p][p]* The base failure chance when reading scrolls (before applying the Reading skill) has been adjusted from 70% + 2/lvl to 55% + 7/lvl, making it easier to read low-level scrolls and making it worthwhile to invest in Reading for higher-level ones (currently, the max level scroll is 6).[/p][p]* Bugfix: Initial items didn’t grant a Tepoztopilli polearm for certain classes when choosing the "Polearms" skill, but did when choosing the "Blunt Weapons" skill. Fixed.[/p][p]* Bugfix: The "Snake Scales" herb existed but its effect wasn't triggered.[/p][p]* Bugfix: Corrected a bug in the Evaluation skill where failing the roll by a large margin printed level difference details, but failing by a small margin printed nothing.[/p][p]* You can now also sacrifice people while they are sleeping.[/p][p]* Added a bonus for kicking NPCs when they are stunned, knocked out, sleeping, or unconscious. Previously, only "held" or "tied up" states were considered.[/p][p]* It is now harder to kick big and super-big NPCs.[/p][p]* Bug report option deactivated.[/p][p]* Removed references to "Tips & Tricks" when dying early; it now points to the official wiki.[/p][p]* Removed the feature that sent morgue files (with consent!) to [url="https://dawnofthemexica.com"]dawnofthemexica.com[/url]. It’s no longer needed.[/p][p]* You can now tie up enemies not only when stunned or knocked out but also when they are unconscious or sleeping.[/p][p]* Version number updated from 1.06 to 1.07 in the Main Menu and Options.[/p][p]* Dynamic scenarios moved to TextAssets (internal adaptation)[/p][p][/p][p]\[NPC changes][/p][p]* Bee Swarm is now level 2 instead of 1 (only affects resistance rolls).[/p][p]* Crotalus Viper now has 6 ranks in Biting instead of 4, more appropriate to its level (hits harder).[/p][p]* Tzitzimime Archer (6th level of Mictlan) now has level 7 instead of 2 (resistance rolls only).[/p][p]* Frost Giant now has 14 ranks in Stomping instead of 12, more appropriate to its level (hits harder).[/p][p]* Tzitzimime Reaper and Tzitzimime Spearthrower (3rd level of Mictlan) now have level 7 instead of 2 (resistance rolls only).[/p][p]* Insane Shaman (Teonanacatl) now has 14 ranks in Spellcasting instead of 12, more appropriate to its level.[/p][p]* Tezcatlipoca Shadow now has 12 ranks in Hiding and One-Handed Blades instead of 10, more appropriate to its level.[/p][p]* Tezcatlipoca Summoner now has 12 ranks in Spellcasting (was 10), and 6 ranks in One-Handed Blades (was 4).[/p][p]* Spanish Priest now has 16 ranks in the Praying skill.[/p][p]* Tlaxcalteca Warrior, who can generate with either a spear or a Macuahuitzoctli Sword, now has 14 ranks in One-Handed Blades (was 8).[/p][p]* Fetus is now vulnerable to piercing damage (-15).[/p][p]* Lost Soul is now vulnerable to electric damage (-20) instead of resistant.[/p][p]* Aluxe Dreamweaver and Aluxe Bloodmage now have 18 ranks in both Meditation and Spellcasting, more appropriate to their level.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Item changes][/p][p]* Bread rotting time increased from 100 turns to 360×3 (3 hours).[/p][p]* Corn cob rotting time increased from 250 to 360 turns.[/p][p]* Wooden Mace now emits 7 noise in combat (previously 3).[/p][p]* Wooden Mace now weighs 0.8 (was 1.7). The previous value was incoherent, since a Macuahuitzoctli Sword is 1.0 and can break into a Wooden Mace.[/p][p]* Sun Mace now emits 7 noise in combat (previously 4).[/p][p]* Sun Mace now weighs 0.8 (was 1.0).[/p][p]* Big Wooden Mace now emits 10 noise in combat (previously 3).[/p][p]* Macuahuitzoctli Sword’s parry bonus is now +5 (was +2). This also applies to the Decorated and Sunlit versions.[/p][p]* Winter Cueitl now weighs 0.2 (was 0.1).[/p][p]* The following items can no longer burn: Tlahuitolli Sunlit Bow, Sunlit Spearthrower, Sun Spear, Jade Pants, Bone Armor, Jade Armor, Leg Greaves, Leather Boots, Leather Shoes, Leather Gloves, Leather Pants, Leather Canteen, and Skeleton Mask.[/p][p]* Lilies (all types) can now burn.[/p][p]* Time to wear Leg Greaves increased from 1.0 to 3.5.[/p][p]* Time to remove Leg Greaves increased from 0.5 to 1.5.[/p][p]* Warmth factor of Leather Pants increased from 8 to 11.[/p][p]* Spanish Cuirass is now slightly better than the standard Cuirass.[/p][p]* Tlaxcalteca Chimalli Buckler is now slightly better than the standard Chimalli Buckler.[/p][p]* Bandages now cure less bleeding: 1d2 + bonus (was 1d4 + bonus).[/p][p]* Tourniquet now cures more bleeding: 1d8 + 3 + bonus (was 1d6 + 2 + bonus).[/p]

notes.title: Dawn of the Mexica - official wiki launched
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39044893/5f14744fa86ac94b5b1012b2c538a612f5a74130.png[/img]

Long time no see!

We're approaching four years since the release of [i]Dawn of the Mexica[/i]. As a developer, I've been involved in other projects ([url=https://smol-kitten.itch.io/checkmate-my-shogi-club-president-cant-be-this-cute]ahem[/url]) and have a few things in the works, but now it feels like the right time to revisit Dawn of the Mexica.

Today, I'm proud to announce the [url=https://dawn-of-the-mexica.fandom.com/wiki/Dawn_of_the_Mexica_Wiki][b]official wiki for Dawn of the Mexica[/b][/url]!

This is something I've wanted to do for a long time, but I was also hesitant—I didn’t want to spoil the fun. I know some players are really hardcore. Some even managed to kill the gods in Mictlán, which was totally unexpected! So, I wanted to give you enough time to uncover the secrets of Dawn of the Mexica on your own. However, four years after release, I think it's finally time to share some of this information.

It's been quite a journey for me to review the code and publish this detailed data. Not everything is included yet, and the wiki itself is still missing some information, like items and unique NPCs. However, it does contain an in-depth description of every enemy in the game, every level, how stats and skills work, and consumables such as liquids, herbs, and scrolls. I've always enjoyed keeping things intentionally obscure, as I think it's more fun that way, but this time, I'm offering plenty of clues. Maybe this will reignite the excitement for some players and encourage them to revisit the game.

That said, be careful! The wiki contains major spoilers. If you’d rather explore Dawn of the Mexica on your own, I suggest staying away for now!

Otherwise, come to the [url=https://dawn-of-the-mexica.fandom.com/wiki/Dawn_of_the_Mexica_Wiki][b]official wiki for Dawn of the Mexica[/b][/url]!

Now, about the future of the game—I'm not sure how to proceed. It's been a long time since the last update, and honestly, I'm a little scared to touch the code. Creating this wiki has also been a way for me to reacquaint myself with it. If I can update the engine and ensure the game is stable, there could be a new version. I've noticed a few things, particularly with the enemies, that I’d like to fix. But for now, nothing is decided.

Anyway, enjoy the wiki!

notes.title: v1.06: Dreamworld branch added
notes.content:
A new deep branch has been added: The tolteca dreamworld of Tlatlauhqui Temictli, the sacred place of dreams that appear in red and bring us to the maternal womb.

Some of its features are:

- Two levels deep.
- 9 new enemy mobs. Meet the mayan aluxes!
- 5 new unique enemies (named and with special skills).
- 4 new monster spells.

Find the library of dreams and find what the tezcatlipoca cultists are looking for in the depths of the tolteca dreamworld!


Other changes in this update:

- Two uniques added to the Teonanacatl branch.
- Kick now spends a small amount of stamina (0.75)
- Kick now wakes up NPC victims if they were sleeping.
- Bug correction: Player made lava (fire magic) didn't generate heat.
- Bug correction: You could carry immobile NPCs to a different level through stairdancing.
- Bug correction: Pressing two keys at the same time could break the menus.

notes.title: Update v1.05
notes.content: Dawn of the Mexica version 1.05 is out! Featuring user defined keybinding for most of the basic actions in the game.

notes.title: Update to versión 1.04
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Back from Christmas holidays, with a few updates and planning some future features like fast-actions and maybe key bindings (though this requires some heavy refactorization).

With this update:

- Random name generator added to character creation, with a few common male and female mexica names.

- Now both stunned and knockout status show in a corner how long they will be active. This will help you strategize better your following actions.

- New unique added: Diego de Landa, the Inquisitor ( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diego_de_Landa )

- Luck bonus now affects weapon critical failures, so if you have enough luck, it will be less likely that you get the harshest (stunned and knocked out) critical failure consequences.

- Change in monster skills, since they were too fast. Internally they're treated like mana-less spells, which means they are too fast. This also will make owls hoot a little less frequently.

- Bugfix: A streamer found a bug in which part of the second level wasn't generated when switching to it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wnKCwbfAT9Y

Its been impossible to replicate the bug, but watching the video closely it must be at 2.37.14 when switching to the Chapultepec level, since it fastly displays Chapultepec (2nd level) then Coatltitlán (1st level). The most likely problem is that the two level changes were so fast that this messed up the internal data.

Really unlikely but it indeed happened, so a fix was added: Internal code preventing level change overlap.

notes.title: Update version 1.03
notes.content:
Changes in this version:

* [b]Four new help screens[/b] which explain player spells.

* New unique character: [b]Yaretzi the Entranced Nahualli[/b]. It comes with a new more monster spell. 

* [b]Heavy optimization on savefiles[/b], so that those from mid-late game become smaller. load/save time in mid-late game has been dramatically decreased

* Fix: [b]Christian priest spells[/b] "iron nails" and "crown of thorns" now take into account your magic resistance.

* Review of the [b]"morgue data"[/b] section, aligning the morgue file data so it is easier to read and changing a couple of colors on the ordering.

* Increased the amount of [b]lillies[/b] in the Chapultepec level.

* Adjustments to [b]fix pixel size[/b] when resizing the resolution in the in-game menu.

* [b]Review of several texts[/b] including the skills part in the inline help.

notes.title: Version 1.02 update
notes.content:
In this update:

* [b]Morguefile browser and reader:[/b] This is a new option in the main menu which reads all morguefiles (summaries of each and every character you've played) and lets you order them by date, XP and turns played. It also features a reader for it.

* [b]< and > bugfix:[/b] This update fixes the problems with US keyboards and '<' '>' keys.

* [b]F1 (help) ingame icon:[/b] This wasn't linked anywhere. You can browse 4 help pages about key bindings, skills and special item codes.

* [b]More uniques:[/b] Added a new unique character (feral teenager) and fixed Cincalco so that there's more variety and some more uniques show up. Uniques are usually enemies (though they can be allies) that randomly show up. They aren't guaranteed to appear in every game.

* [b]Clearer Zoom option highlight[/b] for high definition screens when you start a game or the tutorial.

* [b]Atlatl message[/b] clarifying that you need to wield an atlatl spearthrower to throw atlatl spears when there's spears in the quiver but you have not equipped a spearthrower.

* [b]Easier tutorial:[/b] Your character is a little more powerful in the tutorial, so hopefully it doesn't take too long to kill the rats with spells and bow.

* [b]"Game in progress" warning[/b] when you try to create a new game but you still haven't finished the previous one.

* [b]Tutorial save bugfix:[/b] You could save the game in the tutorial through the bug sending mechanism and thus ruin your character progress. It was very rare since it makes no sense to play the tutorial while there's a real game in course, but still fixed.

* [b]Slight main menu change[/b] in which the occasional red buzzing image doesn't conceal menu options.

notes.title: Version 1.01 - update
notes.content:
CHANGELOG v1.01

This version is released so fast to fix a bug.

- Fixed a critical bug that happened sometimes when reaching the 2nd map. This is what I get for adding content in the last week before release :(

- Meditating now recovers stamina. It uses less time and recovers more stamina the more proficient you are.

- Link to Tips & Tricks if you survive less than 500 turns.

- Sound added when you're drowning.
